description.value: Craft Bierhaus is a bar and restaurant billing itself as being 'in the heart of Revelstoke,' with a kitchen centred on slow-smoked meats — brisket, beef ribs, whole chicken, and pork — alongside rotating craft beers and local BC wines. The OSM record notes outdoor seating, making it a sociable place to unwind after a long day in the saddle. Its central downtown location in Revelstoke positions it as a natural end-of-day stop on popular cycling routes through the Columbia Mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and the /contact subpage confirms the phone number (250) 805-1754 and address 107 2nd Street East, both matching OSM. The menu page uses [v] and [gf] dietary tags across multiple items, providing positive evidence for vegetarian/GF options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, or Wi-Fi was found anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy within the website: the /contact subpage shows '107 2nd Street East' (consistent with OSM) but the site-wide footer repeatedly shows '109 2 St E' — the correct civic address should be verified on the ground.
Email discrepancy: OSM and the /contact subpage list info@craftbierhaus.com, but the site-wide footer lists craftbierhaus@gmail.com — unclear which is the active contact address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service bar and restaurant in downtown Revelstoke with a substantial food menu; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal and drinks.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly tags multiple items [v] (vegetarian) and [gf] (gluten-free): Local Greens salad [v, gf], Kale Caesar [v], Lemon Dill Tzatziki with Pita [v], and all smoked meat mains are marked [gf]
